title: LabExportPacket/v1
description: The PUBLIC export envelope of an SRL lab run: a sanitized, disclosure-safe summary of internal scientific objects, suitable for release across the public boundary. The packet NEVER carries raw private data: no local paths, no commands, no credentials, no raw dataset markers, no T7/VPS topology identifiers, no Pulse/Snapshot/OperatorContext-shaped private keys, and no live/trading/promotion flags. A private object's identity digest is NOT automatically publishable; under disclosure_policy.private_identities='digest_replaced' the exporter substitutes a packet-local digest (sha256(packet_seed + private_digest)) for the raw private digest. The packet is review-only (review_only=true), has no canonical effect (canonical_effect='none'), grants no authority (grants_authority=false), and records no canonical writes (canonical_writes=0). Honesty invariant: exportable != admitted — a packet is a disclosure of summary evidence, never an admission of scientific truth or an authorization to integrate. The canonical ENCODED packet (UTF-8, sorted keys, compact separators, one trailing newline) MUST be at most 1 MiB (1048576 bytes); an oversize packet is a BRIDGE_CONTRACT_MISMATCH refusal, not a truncation. Canonical JSON contract: sorted keys, compact separators, UTF-8, no NaN/Infinity, trailing newline.

packet_id.description: Content-addressed identity of the packet: sha256 over the canonical encoding of the packet (without this field), prefixed 'sha256:'. Computed by the python exporter builder. Because the packet is a public artifact, this digest is itself publishable (it is the packet's identity, not a private object's identity).

created_utc.description: RFC 3339 UTC timestamp at seconds precision (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ) at which the packet was authored. No offset, no fractional seconds.

source_snapshot_digest.description: The content-addressed digest of the internal source snapshot this packet was exported from (a sha256 id), or null when the packet was assembled from loose objects with no single snapshot anchor. When non-null it is a reference to internal provenance, NOT itself a publishable object identity: it is a pointer into private provenance, included for traceability only.

objects.description: The sanitized object summaries included in this export. Each entry carries only a publishable object_digest (possibly a packet-local replacement digest, never the raw private digest when disclosure_policy.private_identities='digest_replaced'), a coarse object_type, a short sanitized_summary, and provenance_refs pointing at the internal objects this summary derives from. The list may be empty (an empty export is a valid disclosure: it says 'nothing was exported').

object_digest.description: The object's digest as it appears in this packet. Either the object's own public digest (when the object is already public and disclosure_policy permits), OR — under disclosure_policy.private_identities='digest_replaced' — a packet-local replacement digest of the form sha256(packet_seed + private_digest), which is uncorrelated with the raw private digest. The exporter guarantees the raw private digest never appears here when the policy says digest_replaced.

object_type.description: A coarse, disclosure-safe object type label (e.g. 'claim', 'evidence_assessment', 'engine_receipt'). Drawn from a small enumerated vocabulary so the packet does not leak internal, private object type names.

sanitized_summary.description: A short, human-readable, disclosure-safe summary of the object. Enforced by the exporter sanitizer: the summary MUST NOT contain absolute local paths (/Users/, /home/, /Volumes/), shell/argv markers, environment-variable assignments, credential patterns, raw-dataset markers, T7 UUIDv7 identifiers, VPS/topology markers, Pulse/Snapshot/OperatorContext-shaped private keys, or live/trading/promotion flags. A summary that would carry any of these is REFUSED at build time (typed BRIDGE_CONTRACT_MISMATCH), never silently stripped — a refused object cannot be exported until it is honestly re-summarized. Max 2000 characters (the schema bounds the on-wire form; the policy summary_max_bytes bounds the byte budget the exporter enforces).

provenance_refs.description: Internal provenance references: the object_ids this summary derives from. Under disclosure_policy.private_identities='digest_replaced' each entry is the packet-local replacement digest (NOT the raw private digest); under 'omitted' the list is empty. Provenance is for traceability; it is not itself authority and does not grant any movement on an evidence axis.

disclosure_policy.description: The disclosure policy the exporter applied to private identities and summaries when building this packet. Carried inline so a reader can verify how each object_digest / provenance_ref was derived. summary_max_bytes is the byte budget the exporter enforced on each sanitized_summary (the schema's 2000-char maxLength is a hard upper bound; a stricter policy may lower it).

private_identities.description: How private object identities were handled. 'digest_replaced': each raw private digest was replaced with a packet-local digest sha256(packet_seed + private_digest), deterministically derivable but uncorrelated with the raw digest (the raw digest never appears in the packet). 'omitted': private identities were dropped entirely (provenance_refs is empty and object_digest is absent or null). The exporter never emits the raw private digest when the policy is digest_replaced.

summary_max_bytes.description: The byte budget the exporter enforced on each sanitized_summary. A positive integer. The schema's per-summary maxLength is 2000 characters; this policy value is the operative byte cap and may be stricter.

review_only.description: Safety const: a packet is for human review only. Always true; a false value is a contract violation. A packet is a disclosure, never an instruction to an automated consumer.

canonical_effect.description: Safety const: exporting a packet has no canonical effect. Always 'none'; any other value is a contract violation. Authoring a packet does not mint, mutate, or retire any canonical object.

grants_authority.description: Safety const: a packet never grants authority on its own. Always false; a true value is a contract violation. A disclosed summary is not an authorization to act, integrate, or promote.

canonical_writes.description: Safety const: authoring a packet performs zero canonical writes. Always 0; a non-zero value is a contract violation. The packet is a read-only view of summary evidence.
